text:
riley: Heads up — during sample-app onboarding I hit logs that expose user email + request_id at DEBUG. Repro steps: set LOG_LEVEL=debug and start the Node sample with `npm run dev`. Logs show `request_id=abc123 user.email=alice@example.com` in cleartext.

riley: I think it's due to the OpenTelemetry hook being installed after the logger is created in our sample app bootstrap. If the OTEL context isn't attached, the logger prints raw context fields instead of the redacted view.

anita: can repro on my mac. same stack: sample-app@0.1.0 -> require('./logger') -> require('@opentelemetry/node') later. Changing order locally (install otel before logger) hides the email as expected.

jamie: ugh. This is a pretty bad onboarding DX for customers trying debug mode. Workarounds: - set LOG_LEVEL=info - set REDWOOD_REDACT=1 (env toggle) but both are awkward. We should ensure safe defaults in debug. :grimacing:

alex: I'll prepare a tiny patch for the sample app to export an async init function so OTEL can be installed first (or at least warn in README). Also adding a test that `LOG_LEVEL=debug` doesn't leak fields named `email`/`ssn` etc.

anita: also noticed pino serializes nested objects; if someone logs `req.context` directly it dumps everything. Could add a serializer that strips keys matching /email|phone|ssn/i by default in our example.

riley: repro logs (trimmed):
```
logger.debug({ request_id: 'abc123', user: { email: 'alice@example.com', id: 'u-1' } }, 'request start')
// output:
// 2026-03-22T18:01:00Z DEBUG request start request_id=abc123 user.email=alice@example.com user.id=u-1
```

jamie: sounds like two fixes: 1) reorder init in sampleapps, 2) add default redaction serializers in SDK quickstart. Both small and high impact.

alex: filed: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sample-apps/pull/432 — reorder start order + README note. Added test and a simple serializer. CI will run.

telemetry-bot: alex pushed 1 commit to branch `fix/otel-before-logger` (CI triggered) :github: 

riley: thanks! once CI passes, can we also add a short blurb in the onboarding doc about how debug logs may expose more fields and how to limit them? simple checklist is fine.

anita: noted, I'll add the checklist to the PR. Also opening a follow-up to the SDK docs to suggest safe serializer snippets for pino/winston.

jamie: quick FYI — this is likely related to the same ordering quirk we've seen with req-id not being attached to traces in unit tests (init timing). Might be worth a short audit across other sample apps (python/go).

riley: agreed. tagging this for a small sweep after the PR merges. :thumbsup:

alex: CI green, tests added, serializers included. PR ready for review.

riley: LGTM, merging now. Thanks everyone.
